svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="ueYP5UOL4T_emls9zIzj"> <mxGraphModel dx="1414" dy="838" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
!theme plain
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

actor \"Operador Principal\n(Telegram)\" as Operador
cloud \"API OpenRouter\n(Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite)\" as OpenRouter

node \"listener.py\n(Motor LangGraph)\" as Listener

package \"Orquestación LangGraph\" {
 database \"EnterpriseState\n(Historial + CTXE)\" as State
 component \"Nodo: GarAI CEO\" as NodoGarAI
 component \"Nodo: Herramientas\" as NodoTools
 
 ' Usamos component en lugar de diamond para evitar el error de sintaxis
 component \"Enrutador\n(Condicional)\" as Enrutador
}

package \"Ecosistema\" {
 folder \"GarAI-Brain\n(USER.md, SOUL.md...)\" as Brain
 file \"shared/tools.py\n(Scripts de Sistema)\" as Tools
}

Operador <--> Listener : Mensajes/Updates
Listener --> NodoGarAI : Inicia Grafo

NodoGarAI <--> State : Lee/Escribe
NodoTools <--> State : Actualiza

NodoGarAI --> Enrutador
Enrutador --> NodoTools : \"[Si contiene 'TOOL:']\"
NodoTools --> NodoGarAI : \"Devuelve Resultado\"

NodoGarAI --> Brain : \"Inyecta Identidad\"
NodoGarAI <--> OpenRouter : \"Inferencia LLM\"
NodoTools --> Tools : \"Ejecuta Python/Bash\"

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="vM4A2vt1bJ-UJ4Gt6vwV-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="795" width="838" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
